body: I dunno about the masamune being better or not, you should check it against a rawrbot on discord to see what stats the leveled up version will have. I wouldn’t do more than one assassins jewel. Most people will tell you not to be fancy and just add crit% or crit damage. Personally I do one assassins jewel, one arisen teardrop and the rest ferocious bullseyes (+4%crit)
